finding_level_note: Member A (mint): uAmount == (vAmount*vPrice)/uPrice notionally selected (exact equality, During, right after L76) but blocked — uPrice (lbt.getUSDVPrice()) has no in-scope call-free reference in mint; call barred from intentValue, no known-bound or exact-formula-inlining rescue. Tag alpha. Member B (burn): mirror on vPrice, vAmount == (uAmount*uPrice)/vPrice, same alpha blocker at L109. Both independently Inexpressible; no target-annotation set constructed since the mechanism requires both members Expressible=Yes.
extraction_note: Two-member case (mint, burn), both Expressible=No (alpha) independently — RQ2-A explicitly marked Not applicable to either member per README §6, so all RQ2-A numeric fields are -1/empty. During/Post was corrected in a later 'Review Notes' section from an earlier draft's Post choice to During (does not change the alpha/Expressible=No verdict) — used the corrected value.
